lines.rg1: A language model only knows what was in its training data, which is frozen in time.
lines.rg2: It cannot see your private documents, or yesterday's news, so it may simply guess.
lines.rg3: Documents are split into chunks, and each chunk becomes an embedding: a point on a map of meaning.
lines.rg4: Your question becomes a point too, and the nearest chunks are retrieved.
lines.rg5: The retrieved chunks are pasted into the prompt, next to your question.
lines.rg6: Now the model answers from real sources, and can even cite them.
lines.outro: Retrieve, augment, generate. That is retrieval augmented generation: it gives the model an open book.
